description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Image Analysis of Settlement-Induced Cracking in Centrifuge Models is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ross Boulanger, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). Image analysis is becoming more commonly used to observe, gather, and understand meaningful information from natural hazards such as slope failures, dam failures, and landslides. Traditionally, the initial and final positions of points are known in a test, but with advanced software, it is possible to gather continuous data on a point on the surface. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-vnac-se13. Keywords: UC Davis Center for Geotechnical Modeling, Image analysis, Differential Settlement, Transverse cracking, Levee, 3D displacements. Published 2022-09-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
